verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no automatic cross-conversation memory. The closest support is Martin's notes capability: it can read, add and edit notes from any interface, and the docs give the example of telling it to note down everything discussed on a call so it can be retrieved later. That is a manual, user-directed workaround rather than the assistant remembering context on its own. Missing for 10: automatic memory of prior chats, evidence that remembered context is applied unprompted in new conversations, memory management or controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
